description: Schedule one or more audio files to play on a Loop Player component (LoopPlayer.Start). This MUTATES the running/emulated system. There is no QRC method to browse Core files — pass a file path you already know. Read Loop Player state back via qsys_get_component.

files.description: One file→output assignment per entry (a Files entry carries only name + output; the options below apply to the whole job)

name.description: Path + filename of the file on the Core (e.g. "Audio/mainloop.wav")

output.description: Output track number to play on

log.description: Log start + errors to the Core event log (default false)

refId.description: If set, the Core logs an async failure notification for this job (the notification is not surfaced by these tools yet)

seek.description: Offset into the file to start playback, in seconds (default 0)

startTime.description: -1 = now, -2 = queue after current, ≥0 = absolute time-of-day (s). Omitted → Core default (0). With Time source "None", 0 plays now and >0 has no effect.

name: qsys_loop_player_start
title: Start Loop Player playback
